chapter: New Orleans, Havana and back to New York
title: Returning to New York and recapping the chronology
summary: After trying to get something going in California he went back to New York and formed the Paramount band; Willard reads Chilton's timeline.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So when you came back to California you were sidelining in these films, "Sally, Irene and Mary," and -- I can't remember the other one you mentioned.
And, you know, trying to get something going musically, which there wasn't too much going on. Then I went back to New York, and that's when I organized the band that went into the Paramount.
And who was in that band?
I already gave you that. That was the one with Van Cleve and --
Oh, oh, oh. The Paramount Hotel.
I'm sorry. I was thinking all of a sudden --
When you say the Paramount, you always think of the theater.
;Yeah. Okay. So we are chronologically now back to New York from Havana, right?
Okay. And was that -- the new band, in the spring of '35? Disbanded, moved to Hollywood, for short lived acting career. Now there's, "Love and Hisses," "Sally, Irene and Mary."
Okay. Reformed own band. Residencies at Glenn Island Casino and touring. Disbanded, then reformed band for residency at Famous Door.
